en: I already had no expectation of you arriving on time for once...
But what's with the clothes?
Ask Rims and Berry.
This is them doing things their way.
We're going to throw a tea party in our style!
And what does that mean, exactly?
W-We're bringing our club staff along to throw an extravagant tea party.
Isn't it boring to have the same old tea party every time?
Aha, is that so?
And where are these so-called staff?
That's the exciting part!
That's your cue, Sil!
I'm as lost as you are. Hyup!
What's this?
We had a few issues sourcing the staff.
...And also all the materials.
Oh?
I warned you.
If you don't honor your end of the contract again, I'm done!
Not only are you late, you're not even fully prepared...
You're only interested in using the tea party to advance your own business interests!
Why do you think it's so difficult gathering everyone for each tea party?
Because they're so duuuuuull!!
What's wrong with having a little fun once in a while?
Just once...?
I can't remember a single time the tea party has proceeded properly or on time!
Chloe...?
I was a fool to believe I could teach you girls some semblance of responsibility.
I can't believe I struggled so long before realizing the futility.
C-Chloe... We'll...
I don't want to hear it.
...Take this.
You'll need it for the "boring ritual" you all hate so much.
And...
The garden ends this year.
Phew, we knew there'd be a fight.
You're really great at setting the tone, Chloe.
...I would have preferred it if she was angry.
Seeing her so disappointed, I just feel bad.
Anyway, we were able to get the rest of the materials thanks to Chloe, so maybe the tea party will work out after all.
Maybe...
I'm going to go see Nahatra first. We can worry about this all later.
Nahatra, I'm here.
I don't know if you'll like what Rims and Berry have planned for the tea party.
Urk! This is...
It's so unstable... Is it because Chloe's seal is gone now?
Nahatra's waking up too quickly!
Phew, that was a close one.
Are you okay, Nahatra?
That took longer than usual, Sil.
But thanks to that, we had plenty of time to finish preparing, hehe.
Hoohoohoo... Hahaha!!!
I got impatient waiting, so I drank another glass!
I'm going back to my farm.
Doesn't having "staff" acting like that reflect poorly on your club?
Who cares!
It's what's on the outside that counts!
...Isn't it supposed to be the inside?
...Whatever.
Let's just get this tea party started.
Ta-da!
Oh my! What's all this?
Did you prepare all this?
Hehehe!
Impressive, right?
If I'm honest, my expectations were rock bottom when I got your invitation.
And now??
Surprisingly...
It's nowhere near as bad as I expected.
Yippee! Sil knows quality!
But won't Nahatra find it too unfamiliar?
Come on, I'm sure she'll love it!
Sorry, Nahatra.
Chloe left already.
There was a little disagreement, hehe.
But that's okay, you're still the star of the show!
We hope you have fun, Nahatra!
I guess this tea party is not Nahatra's cup of tea.
Or rather...
I think it's because Chloe's not here.
She announced she's ending the tea parties altogether.
...Is it really a big deal?
A tea party cannot be organized without the witches who signed the contract.
And without the tea party, Nahatra will fully awaken from her slumber...
At which point, the garden comes to the end.
Aha, is that so?
I'll have to make sure to finish off all the concoctions I've been saving!
I'll stay on my farm until then.
Well, bye then!
Huh? Where's everyone going? We're supposed to be having fun!
Seems like nobody's in the mood.
The garden has just been given its death sentence.
*sigh*
Well, that is quite depressing.
We should go back to the club too.
It seems we ought to do some self-reflection.
Let's just make sure the next tea party is twice as fun!
...If there is a next time ☆
Ahahahahaha!
...Don't worry too much, Nahatra.
We'll figure something out, I'm sure... Heh...
With a knot woven by the Thread Witch.
With dewdrops brewed by the Flower Witch.
With soil sprinkled by the Pumpkin Witch.
With flesh devoured by the Blood Witch.
With a flame lit by the Wax Witch.
In the name of all witches, we will now host our tea party.
Okay, the tea party is ready!
Now if we can just get Chloe to change her mind, we'll have nothing to worry about.
Didn't she insist she was stopping the tea parties.
So we just need to try to talk her out of it.
And if you can't?
Well, in that case...
We'll just need to host the tea party a witch short.
I'll take one of your whiskers for now.
Ouch!
It's probably not a suitable substitute, but...
You're a witch too, after all.
You're going to pay for this disrespect.
I'll pay when I get back.
If I can make it back in one piece...
I won't need these big scissors this time.
They won't be any use if the tea party doesn't go ahead.
Still, isn't it a good idea to take them just in case?
It'll be nice as a memento.
You're too blunt for a cat.
If I don't make it back, you can keep it yourself.
I don't need it. It's yours.
I'll see you later, Sil.
...Right. See you later.
Siiiil! Heeeelp!
Fiena?
And... is that Chloe?!
What's going on?
Chloe drank all my beloved concoctions!
Pwah! Phew...
Eh? The bottle's empty!
Chloe...?
My precious concoctions!
This is a whole new side of Chloe...
She won't even have a sip of tea before ensuring everything is set up perfectly.
She's been like that ever since she sat down in my flower garden.
She's drinking my concoctions faster than I can make them!
I never expected her to change like this so immediately after ending the contract.
Ugh, my head...
Who're you? Sil...?
I haven't felt this carefree in years! Why're you here?
Umm, Chloe...
We're on the way to the tea party. Care to join?
Pfft, no thanks.
Now pour me another, you dumb witch!
I want to stay intoxicated right up to the garden's final second!
Yahahaha!!
Sorry, I'll pour you another right away!
Hmm, what do we do...?
Can you blame her?
It's natural to want a good drink when your heart is troubled!
When your heart is troubled...
She announced she'd stop attending the tea parties.
But perhaps her heart wasn't fully in it.
Hmm...
Do you think you'll be able to drag her along to the tea party somehow?
Eh? Meeee?
Do you think she'll listen to me? She's completely intoxicated!
Lure her with more bottles of your concoction or something.
I'll take over from there.
All right, I'll see what I can do.
Hi, Abigail.
Have you been baking bread? I love the smell!
Tarts...
And pies, and cakes, and muffins...
I'm busy baking all of them.
Oh, I see.
But, isn't it a little much?
The garden will disappear soon.
So.. I made everything I'd always wanted to make.
Is that bad?
Oh, no, not at all.
I'm glad, actually!
It's nice to see you so enthusiastic about the tea party.
If I want to protect my farm...
Then I need to protect the garden.
I finally realized that.
Umm, and...
And...?
Exploring the garden with you...
...was kind of fun.
That's all.
Aha...
Well, then.
I'll see you at the tea party!
Okay.
Oh, hello Sil! Hehe!
Care for a glass?
No, thank you.
But what's the deal?
The atmosphere is very different from usual.
It seems this garden will soon be coming to an end.
It'll be hard to keep the club open in such an event.
All the staff are on indefinite leave.
Hehe, their first and last vacation.
What about the tea party?
Haven't you seen Chloe? She's in no condition for tea partying.
So we thought we might as well have a tea party among ourselves at least.
We have no regrets, unlike the living.
We go where we must, Sil, just like the dead.
It's not like you two to be so sullen.
We should at least try something.
Fiena said she'll try her best to bring Chloe.
And you actually trust her to?
Heh. Leaving a mess to another mess!
Your time would be better spent thinking about how to finish up your life in the garden,
...All right.
Fine.
How about we think of it this way?
If we can't hold a tea party...
What about a party to commemorate the death of the garden?
I know we haven't always been on the best of terms, but...
If the garden has to end, I'd like you to be there with me when it does.
Hmmmmmmm...
Sorry. Don't feel like it.
Oh, okay then...
Ahahahahaha! Woohoohoohoohoo!
Just kidding. We're in!
There's nothing funnier than that look you have when you're desperate!
Hehe! As long as we get to be in charge of party materials!
A death party... Hehehehe!
Fine, whatever gets you to attend.
Is everyone here?
I don't see Fiena or Chloe.
I'm heeeeere!!
Alone?
Where's Chloe...?
I was brewing up an extra special concoction just for her, like you said...
And just as I was taking a sip—
Ahem, just as I turned away for a moment... she vanished!
Vanished?
She really is adamant about not participating in the tea party.
To think, my last memory of Chloe will be of her being completely a mess...
So...
Are we not doing the tea party?
Will I lose... my farm?
Hmm...
I brought along part of another witch in the hope it would be enough to take Chloe's place...
Is that... a cat's whisker?
Poor Canele!
Will it be enough?
How can it replace a witch like Chloe...
Of course it won't be enough.
But fret not!
Because this is a death party, not a tea party!
Hehehe!
The garden isn't dying yet!
I'll... I'll go see Nahatra.
Hello, Nahatra.
Wow, a tea party where nobody was late!
How long has it been since that last happened?
I don't think it ever has.
This is the first.
Sorry...
Chloe didn't come this year either.
We're sad about it too.
But we worked hard to prepare everything! So can you please forgive us...?
Yes, let's start the tea party.
With a knot woven by the Thread Witch.
With dewdrops brewed by— HIC! Oops, sorry, hehe.
*sigh*
A toast to our club and final legacy!
With... uhh... a flame lit by a cat's whisker.
In the name of all witches, we will now host our tea party.
Did it work...?
Huh?!
Ahaha! Looks like a no!
Nahatra is having nightmares again.
I knew we were forcing it too hard!
Don't worry, girls!
Sil will stop the nightmares for us, won't you?
What use would it be?
If there's no tea party, Nahatra will wake up sooner or later anyway!
Hehe, it's so like the living to be afraid of death!
It's only natural, Rims.
The living fear endings, hehe...
Wahaha! It really is the end!
I'll see you outside the garden in the next life, girls!
But one last drink before we leave, hehe...
Oh?
Why do I feel so... light?
Aghh! I don't wanna die!!!
Chloe?
What...
...are you all doing here?
Having a tea party, what else!
Looks cool, right?
Though it's ended up being a little weird...
See, we held the tea party at the right time for once!
Pfft...
Bwahahahaha!!
Ha, fine, laugh as much as you like.
Ahahaha! It's so funny.
How can you call this a tea party?
But...
Chloe...
This is the first time...
...that we've thrown the tea party, having truly put our all into it.
Your all?
And this is how it ended up?
You're all so ridiculous!
A tea party is an important ritual that brings everyone together to defend our one and only world.
It's not some silly playtime!
Is that how you insist on defining the tea party?
Yes, this tea party was just a contractual obligation at first...
The process of putting it together every year was always complete chaos, and not a single witch was ever on time.
But with each tea party we threw together...
It became more than an obligation. It's a time for us all to reminisce on our memories with one another.
Hmph. Reminisce?
Right, I'm sure they're all pleasant memories for you...
Well now you can wallow in your regrets instead!
No matter what happens, I refuse to cooperate with a tea party ever, ever again!
No matter what?
Do you really mean that?
Then... why are you here?
Uhh... Well...
Sure, it's come quite late, but we've all finally realized...
Just how important this tea party is.
Pah! How many times have I heard nonsense like that now?
We really mean it this time, Chloe.
Most of all, if we don't have this tea party...
Nahatra will fully awaken.
And then the garden will be shrouded in darkness.
Sounds good to me!
But then...
What about that library of yours you cherish so much?
Ack...
The collections you've worked so hard to amass...
The books you've still yet to read...
And those novels you didn't think we knew you'd been writing.
I-I-I've not written any novels!!
Chloe...
We all came to the garden in search of a life of our own...
That we couldn't find anywhere else, right?
Please, can you not give us one last chance?
We really have changed.
Sil...
Now!!
Eh?!
I got her candle!
Hehe! Such a good, rule-abiding witch!
Even at a time like this, you made sure to gather the correct materials!
Y-You tricked me!
You mean to force me to take part against my will...
You... You wicked witches!!!
Who cares, as long as the contract is fulfilled!
Now... In the name of all witches, we will host our tea party!!
...Are we still alive, Berry?
It would appear so, Rims.
You did it, Sil! You're amazing!!
Why...
Do we really need to have this tea party?
For how long do we need to keep repeating this? Forever?
I don't know the answer to that either, Chloe.
But, for now, I'd like to stay in this garden for a while longer.
Me too.
Think of it as a lingering attachment of the dead.
No other place embraces both the dead and the living like this garden!
Abigail says she wants to stay here for a while longer too!
...I think? Hoohoohoo!
And you, Chloe?
...Ha. Look at me.
What can I do?
I'll just have to continue nagging at you all!
Fine, let's stay here until we're all sick of each other.
Even if it means doing this stupid tea party again and again!
So read my lips!!
For the hundredth time...
If you sincerely wish to protect the garden...
Will you please just show up on time!!!
From this tea party onwards...
You better not be even a single millisecond late!!
Got it?!?!
Got it!!!
